title: Addition of Product Characters
statement: For every positive integer $m$, every natural number $n$, and all functions $\alpha,\beta:\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\mathbb Z/m\mathbb Z$, the product character indexed by the pointwise sum $\alpha+\beta$ is the pointwise product of the product characters indexed by $\alpha$ and $\beta$.
